Color identity: RWB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{R}
Produces: Each opponent sacrifices nearly infinite creatures; Infinite card draw; Infinite draw triggers; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite lifeloss; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite storm count
Start: Forum Necroscribe (battlefield); Priest of Forgotten Gods (graveyard); Traitorous Greed (hand, graveyard); Living Lightning (battlefield); Field of Souls (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
Steps: Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
  Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
  Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
  When Living Lightning dies, it and Field of Souls triggers.
  Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
  Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
  Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

Color identity: RWB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite death triggers; Infinite mill; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite self-mill
Start: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight (battlefield); Altar of Dementia (battlefield); Cryptborn Horror (battlefield: without a -1/-1 counter on it)

  Repeat.

## Combo 5276-5332-5686-6524
Cards: Carmen, Cruel Skymarcher + Leonin Relic-Warder + All-Out Assault + Shilgengar, Sire of Famine
Color identity: RWB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}{R}{W}{B}
Produces: Infinite artifact tokens; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite lifegain; Infinite combat phases; Infinite untap of creatures you control; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite Blood tokens; Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature
Start: Carmen, Cruel Skymarcher (battlefield: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent ); Leonin Relic-Warder (graveyard); All-Out Assault (hand); Shilgengar, Sire of Famine (battlefield)
Steps: Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
  When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
  Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
  Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
  Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
  When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
  Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
  Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
  When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
  Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
  Repeat from step 3.

  Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
  Repeat.
